behavior: Native worlds fill the view; the navigation/status bars are hidden. One 44-point floating menu sits in the upper-right corner, above the realm title.
Close world is available while loading and playing; the existing editor is offered where the world exposes it, and a loading failure offers Retry. Opening the menu clears held game input.

The shared Splice touch adapter converts positive-up engine pitch to the game’s positive-down mouse delta. Upward drag looks up and downward drag looks down. Horizontal look and mouse input are unchanged.
The existing inventory codec rebinds the rebuilt Splice producer to the same 26 immutable asset records. No game packs are bundled.
1079’s compact transcripts and main’s model/effort controls are retained.
